entities.title: A refused reign is reported as an unreachable table
entities.summary: When the server refuses a reign (its seed expired or was used, or its keys no longer replay), the name entry says the table can't be reached and invites another try that cannot succeed.
entities.expected: A reign the server refuses is reported as one that can't go on the table, and the player is sent on, as when they skip; only a network failure invites another try.
entities.observed: call() turns every failure, a refusal (409, 422) as much as a lost connection, into null, and offerTable answers null with "The table can't be reached." and keeps the entry open, so ENTER sends the same refused reign again.
reproduction: Start a reign, and submit it more than 24 hours after its seed was issued, or after a deploy that changed the engine
acceptanceCriteria: A 409 or 422 answer says the reign can't be entered and leaves the entry.
A network failure still keeps the entry open for another try.

origin.description: Found while reading src/scores.ts and src/main.ts against worker/index.ts for the .dev files.
